module: Shared axis gizmo handling for the editor's spline editing tools. Places the gizmo on the selected node (or on a display anchor position), moves the node in translation (or all nodes in rigid mode), rotates the normals around the local tangent, and records the drag in the undo history.
notes: The state (splines, indices, callbacks) is kept in module variables: it is rewritten on every call to handleGizmo.
Rotation is only possible around the local tangent; the gizmo is forced to local alignment in rotation and to world alignment when switching to translation.
setAxisGizmoTranslateLock(true, true, not isConformToTerrain): vertical translation (Z) depends on the terrain conform mode (Z lock = not conform, as written in the code).
At the end of the drag, spline.isDirty is set back to true so that the final state triggers a rebuild.

handleGizmo.desc: To be called every frame: positions, updates and draws the gizmo on the selected node of a spline, and configures the axis locks. During a drag, the node follows the cursor; releasing commits the 'Gizmo Drag' action in the history.

splinesIn.desc: List of splines (each with nodes, nmls, isDirty).

isConformToTerrainIn.desc: Terrain-conforming spline (Z not free on the gizmo).

isRigidIn.desc: Rigid translation/rotation applied to all nodes.

deepCopyFunctIn.desc: Deep copy of a spline's state, for the history.

commitHistoryOverrideIn.desc: Replaces editor.history:commitAction to group the drag into a larger action.

anchorPosIn.desc: Display position of the gizmo instead of the node; nil = on the node.

isDragging.desc: True while a gizmo drag (translation or rotation) is in progress; allows heavy rebuilds to be deferred.
